title: Clarify Product Registry authority, identifiers and submission trust
requirements:
- State whether the registry is the regulatory source, a master-data hub or a federated view
- State that the registry records externally assigned GTINs rather than issuing them
- Make bulk onboarding or equivalent migration capability mandatory with validation and rollback
- Add organisational verification, submission provenance and separation of submitter and approver
- Make regulatory status mandatory where regulation applies, with exempt/emergency categories
- Require level-aware national-to-global mappings with mapping type
- Make external-source integrations conditional on a country source strategy
- Use attribute- and product-class-specific approval workflows
